description: An overhead still life shows twelve glossy square ceramic tiles in two neat rows of six on a warm cream textured surface. Both rows begin with a navy tile followed by two ivory tiles. The fourth tile is blue-gray in the top row and ochre in the bottom row; both rows end with an ivory tile and a blue-gray tile. A separate ochre tile rests in a shallow speckled ceramic tray at the upper right. A brass magnifying glass lies at the lower right, its handle pointing toward the bottom-right corner. A round pale ceramic vase with leafy green branches enters from the upper left, while folded striped cloth and a stone slab enter from the lower left. Warm directional light produces soft shadows. The restrained earth tones, orderly spacing, and open background give the scene a calm, deliberate visual mood.
